# awacino_active_connections (Data Source)

Who is connected to which Beam-in device right now (read-only, for checks and outputs). Members are shown by id, code holders by the code's label and their device name - never another account's e-mail. Key section **Connections** (Read). API: `/v1/connections/active`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "awacino_device" "web01" {
  name = "web-01"
}

data "awacino_active_connections" "web01" {
  device_id = data.awacino_device.web01.id
}

output "connected_now" {
  value = [for c in data.awacino_active_connections.web01.connections : "${c.via}: ${c.peer_name} since ${c.since}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device_id` (String) Only this Beam-in device.
- `member_id` (String) Only this member.
- `via` (String) `member`, `own_device` or `beamin_code`.

### Read-Only

- `connections` (Attributes List) The live connections. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connections))

<a id="nestedatt--connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connections`

Read-Only:

- `code_id` (String) The Beam-in code (via = beamin_code).
- `code_label` (String) The code's label.
- `device_id` (String) The Beam-in device reached.
- `device_name` (String) Its name.
- `id` (String) Connection id.
- `member_id` (String) The member (via = member).
- `peer_name` (String) Name of the connecting device.
- `peer_platform` (String) Its platform.
- `since` (String) Connected since.
- `via` (String) `member`, `own_device` or `beamin_code`.
